Then precipitation stats: location: Amazon rainforest, time_frame: year and five_years. We'll call the function twice for restaurant search? Actually we can call once with cuisine: Thai, then again with cuisine: Italian. Or we can call twice. The user wants both. So we need to call restaurant_find_nearby twice.
